{{Quote|It is a pity you had to hear that message Vana Sage. Now we have no choice but to terminate your contract.''"<br />"What!"<br />"''And as further terms section twenty-three E, paragraph 5, we reserve the right to terminate your employment with force.|A Trade Federation officer fires Vana Sage|<ref name="NEC" />}}
A '''skirmish at Eos''' occurred when the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] attempted to terminate [[Vana Sage]] after she discovered incriminating evidence against the Federation. The Trade Federation found out that Vana Sage had heard a message tying them to a [[Attempted kidnapping of Queen Amidala|failed attempt]] to capture [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] while Sage was working for them over [[Eos]]. Sage defended herself in her [[Guardian Mantis|starfighter]] from Federation [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] until only one damaged [[Hunter-Seeker droid]] remained. Sage followed the droid to the surface of Eos and discovered the Trade Federation's secret factory and [[Mining/Legends|mining]] facilities. A [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] was activated that trapped Sage there, but she destroyed the shield projectors to escape Eos for good. This event was the first of a series of times Vana Sage would fight the Trade Federation.

==Prelude==
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] hired a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to capture [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. With some help from the Federation, the group [[Attempted kidnapping of Queen Amidala|ambushed]] Amidala's [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|starship]], but the Queen ultimately escaped the trap.<ref name="SF2" /> One mercenary sent a coded message to the Trade Federation give them the news. The Trade Federation had contracted the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Vana Sage]] to perform tests on [[Scarab-class starfighter/Legends|''Scarab''-class]] [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] near [[Eos]].<ref name="SF3" />

==The fight==
===Space===
{{Quote|A coded transmission? Intercept and play it, Mod-3.''"<br />"''&hellip;at least 25 ships destroyed. We suffered considerable losses. The queen has returned to Naboo. We were unable to take out the rest of&mdash;''"<br />"''Jammed!|Vana Sage detects the message about the aftermath of the Trade Federation's attempted kidnapping of Queen Amidala|<ref name="NEC" />}}
[[File:Skirmish_at_Eos.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Vana Sage]] tests [[Scarab-class starfighter/Legends|Scarabs]].]]
While performing the tests, Sage's droid, [[Mod-3]] detected the coded message from the mercenary. Decoding it, Sage listened to a mercenary describe the recently failed attempt to kidnap Queen Amidala, until she was [[Jammer/Legends|jammed]] by her Trade Federation supervisor. The Federation employee then sent numerous [[Hunter-Seeker droid]]s after Sage and left the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. After managing to destroy all the droids, a wing of mercenary starfighters emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="SF3" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)}}
The mercenaries attacked Sage, but she managed to defeat all of them.<ref name="SF3" />
{{Endgame}}
After the fighting, Mod-3 scanned the wreckage and found a lone, damaged Hunter-Seeker droid heading toward [[Eos]]. Thinking the planet was uninhabited, Sage decided to follow the droid.<ref name="SF3" />

===Planet surface===
Sage followed the droid to a large mining facility. Moments after Sage arrived at the complex, a [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] was activated over the area, trapping her inside. Staying calm, Sage determined that destroying seven of the eight [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]] would bring down the shield. Evading more Hunter-Seeker droids and [[Turret droid|other defensive weapons]], Vana was able to destroy the generators and flee the planet.<ref name="SF4" />

==Aftermath==
Vana Sage would later return to Eos with [[Nym/Legends|Nym]], [[Rhys Dallows]], and [[Reti]] to destroy the [[droid factory]] and prevent an [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion of Naboo]]. Thanks to Vana's earlier sabotage the Trade Federation was unable to use their defensive shield to protect their facilities, and the factory was destroyed in the ensuing [[Battle of Eos (Invasion of Naboo)|battle]].<ref name="SF8">[[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']] Level 8: "Taking the Offensive"</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This article was based on two consecutive missions in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']]. For these two missions, "Contract Infraction" and "Secrets on Eos," players take the role of Vana Sage, one of the game's three protagonists. Destroying all mercenary fighters, all droids dispensers and all mining droids are bonus objectives; this article assumes 100% completion.
